bundle.shortDescription: The safe way for people and AI to query production databases
bundle.longDescription: SayQL Community Edition is a free desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server and Azure SQL. Ask a question in plain English and get SQL as you type, written by the AI you choose, then run it read-only, so nothing changes unless you say so. AI apps such as Claude and Cursor can query through it too, within the limits you set.
